title: I am's nightmare
description: This modpack WITH GUNS AND MONSTERS fore true people that will need to be extremelly sharp on resources and ammo.
body:
🩸 I Am’s Nightmare
Welcome to I Am’s Nightmare, a world where Minecraft’s comfort turns into pure terror. Darkness spreads faster, monsters stalk you from the fog, and the silence is broken only by what hunts nearby. Every torch feels like hope — and every shadow hides something worse.

Explore a twisted version of survival where fear is your biggest enemy. Strange whispers echo through caves, ancient ruins hide cursed secrets, and the nights never truly end. Your goal? Stay alive long enough to understand what happened to this world — and to yourself.

Features:

Realistic darkness and terrifying atmosphere 🌑

Horrifying mobs and unpredictable encounters 👹

Blood-chilling sounds and ambient effects 🎧

Survival, exploration, and psychological horror combined 🔪

Perfect for solo survival or multiplayer scares 💀

You can run, you can hide… but you can’t escape I Am’s Nightmare.
